meta.title: 今天看到的，有审美启发的图

scenes.context: 第一张图的启发是浅蓝色上衣搭配小鸡黄裤子，很清新很夏天。博主用亚麻色宽肩带包+银色系配饰中和掉铜絮感。黄黑皮也可以大胆尝试彩色撞色。语域：审美分享，配色分析。
sentences: 浅蓝上衣配小鸡黄裤子，很夏天。
A sky-blue top with chicks-yellow pants feels summery.
feels summery（很夏天）
亚麻色包和银色配饰中和整体感。
Linen bag and silver accessories tie it together.
tie it together（中和整体）
黄黑皮也可以大胆尝试彩色。
Warm-toned skin can boldly try color too.
boldly try color（大胆尝试彩色）
paraphrase: 中和 → tie together / balance out
黄黑皮 → warm-toned skin / golden-dark skin
scenes.speak: A sky-blue top with chicks-yellow pants feels summery. Linen bag and silver accessories tie it together. Warm-toned skin can boldly try color too.

scenes.context: 第二张图的启发是穿搭和身后背景撞色：下装的绿色和背景里的红色撞色。另外细吊带上衣+扎头发时，脸到胸前显空，可以加围巾或长项链填补，腮红也打明显一点。语域：审美分享，撞色与配饰。
sentences: 下装的绿和背景的红，形成撞色。
Green bottoms against a red background make a bold clash.
a bold clash（撞色）
细吊带上衣，脸到胸前显空。
A thin-strap top leaves the chest area empty.
leaves the chest empty（胸前显空）
加围巾或长项链填补。
Fill it with a scarf or long necklace.
a long necklace（长项链）
paraphrase: 撞色 → color clash / contrasting colors
填补 → fill the space / add detail
scenes.speak: Green bottoms against a red background make a bold clash. A thin-strap top leaves the chest area empty. Fill it with a scarf or long necklace.

scenes.title_en: Small Color Accents and Chunky Bracelets
scenes.context: 第三张的启发：全身都是基础色时，用帽子上小字母和手镯做小面积撞色，拍照很好看。粗手镯量感大，显得手腕更细，今年很流行。语域：审美分享，配饰运用。
sentences: 全身基础色，用配饰做小面积撞色。
All basics? Add small color accents with accessories.
small color accents（小面积撞色）
粗手镯显手腕细。
Chunky bracelets make wrists look slimmer.
chunky bracelets（粗手镯）
这种量感大的款式今年很火。
The big-statement style is trendy this year.
big-statement（量感大）
paraphrase: 小面积 → small accents / pops of color
scenes.speak: All basics? Add small color accents with accessories. Chunky bracelets make wrists look slimmer. The big-statement style is trendy this year.

scenes.context: 妆容启发：晒伤妆如果配深色瞳孔会显得燥热，可以换成浅蓝色眼珠中和；蓝色美瞳配淡妆，用红调眼影画下眼线，眼妆更干净。还有痣可以点三颗：鼻上一颗、眼下外眼角一颗、脸颊一颗。语域：审美分享，妆容技巧。
sentences: 晒伤妆配浅蓝眼珠，中和燥热。
Sunkissed makeup pairs with light-blue eyes to cool the heat.
to cool the heat（中和燥热）
蓝色美瞳，配淡妆更干净。
Blue contacts work best with clean, light makeup.
clean, light makeup（干净淡妆）
痣点三颗，面部更丰富。
Three beauty marks make the face richer.
beauty marks（痣）
paraphrase: 晒伤妆 → sunkissed makeup / beachy glow
scenes.speak: Sunkissed makeup pairs with light-blue eyes to cool the heat. Blue contacts work best with clean, light makeup. Three beauty marks make the face richer.

practice: A sky-blue top with chicks-yellow pants feels summery.
Green bottoms against a red background make a bold clash.
Chunky bracelets make wrists look slimmer.
Three beauty marks make the face richer.
pitfalls: Green bottoms against a red background make a bold clash.
「撞色」用 color clash，不是都配同色。
Chunky bracelets make wrists look slimmer.
「粗手镯」用 chunky bracelets，量感大显手腕细。
Sunkissed makeup pairs with light-blue eyes.
Three beauty marks make the face richer.
shifts: 用 color clash（撞色）、small color accents（小面积撞色）、tie it together（整体感）
用 chunky bracelet（粗手镯）、big-statement（量感大）、long necklace（长项链）
用 sunkissed makeup（晒伤妆）、beauty marks（痣）、cool the heat（中和燥热）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：浅蓝上衣配小鸡黄裤子、亚麻色包+银色配饰中和、黄黑皮大胆撞色、绿配红撞色、细吊带胸前显空、围巾长项链填补、基础色+小面积撞色、粗手镯显手腕细、晒伤妆配浅蓝眼珠、蓝色美瞳配淡妆、点三颗痣等。
